import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Standardize Category labels to the allowed canonical values
    cat_map = {
        'accessories': 'Accessories',
        'office supplies': 'Office Supplies',
        'furnture': 'Furniture'
    }
    df['Category'] = (
        df['Category']
        .str.strip()
        .str.title()
        .replace(cat_map)
    )
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (keeps first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Average unit price (Price) per Category, dropping rows with missing Category
    avg_price = (
        df.dropna(subset=['Category'])
        .groupby('Category')['Price']
        .mean()
        .round(2)
    )
    return avg_price.to_dict()
